content.short: Hashflow is a multi-chain DEX that uses a Request-for-Quote (RFQ) model to provide zero slippage and MEV protection.
content.description:
Hashflow is a decentralized exchange (DEX) designed for high-performance trading with zero slippage and MEV-protected execution. Unlike traditional automated market makers (AMMs), Hashflow uses a Request-for-Quote (RFQ) model that allows professional market makers to provide liquidity directly to users. This approach ensures that traders receive the best possible prices without the risk of front-running. The protocol also supports seamless cross-chain swaps.

By leveraging its unique RFQ engine, Hashflow bridges the gap between decentralized and centralized liquidity. This architecture provides institutional-grade trading features to the Web3 community while maintaining the security of on-chain settlement. Hashflow empowers users to trade with confidence across multiple blockchains through a transparent and efficient interface.
